name: verifier
comment: Every version is pinned exactly, with a lockfile, because this manifest is
installed at image build time and the image has to score the same tree the
same way in month six as on the day it was authored. A range here would let
a new eslint-plugin-react-hooks rename a rule out from under a gate spec.
playwright is pinned to the recorder's release for a second reason: the
expectations were recorded with that browser build, and chart label
coordinates in a canvas transcript follow font metrics.
